purpose: Seeds replayed by tests/fuzz/test_fuzz.py. Every bug a fuzz run finds and fixes adds its target, seed and iteration count here with the fix it belongs to; the runs are deterministic, so a seed is a reproducer.

state_runs.note: baseline; 300 mutated states per session, with and without a disk. The only finding: DISK_update shifted the -1 of DSKSYNC(-1, v) left in every state load (UBSan), patch 0102
